_doc: House voice standard (sv-12-voice). Shared by every episode; do not edit per episode. Changing it is a series decision (user request), made in the suite template with a CHANGELOG line; G3 goes stale where it changed. Calibrated 2026-11-16 by a temperature x top_k sweep (6 lines x 2 seeds per setting) on the preset voice; the user approved the one-take result (research/tts-expressive, bản E).

engine._why: t0.8/k25 had the best word accuracy (0.87) and no holes; t0.95 drifted in timbre (CV 0.12), lower temperatures misread more. Cloning (even from Hải Đăng's own takes) lost bandwidth (~12.5 kHz) and added artefacts; the user rejected it. One take with a fixed seed: the same text always gives the same audio. A retry (next seed) happens only when a line fails a check below.

text._doc: rules for the text sent to the engine (tts_text if present, else text). script_lint SC-15..SC-17 and voice.py both enforce them.
text._why: digits are read unpredictably -> write numbers in words; every '...' or decorative comma became a 0.3-0.5 s hole and slowed the read ~20 %; emotion tags [cười]/[thở dài]/[hắng giọng] are experimental and lowered word accuracy, so they are off for the series

line_checks._doc: every generated line is measured against profile (below). [min, max]. A line that fails any check is regenerated with the next seed, up to engine.max_attempts.
line_checks._why: asr = voice.py similarity (accent-free, character level, whisper-small): calibration takes are >= 0.90 at p10, 0.85 is the floor the old best-of-N used. Rate +-12 % = calibration spread 4.22-4.95. Pitch +-2 st and timbre +-20 % are 1.3x the spread seen between good lines (content changes both); beyond that the line sounds like another read. A hole > 0.55 s inside a line is a broken read (natural sentence breaks measured 0.26-0.43 s).

profile._doc: Hải Đăng at the engine settings above, measured by voice.py measure() on 12 calibration takes. Rate = words / trimmed line length (Vietnamese words = syllables).
profile.calibrated: 2026-11-16, 39 lines: the 12 sweep takes (con-so-dam-ma s1-s5, 2 seeds) + all 27 lines of a full one-take run of con-so-dam-ma; asr_similarity p10 0.937 (numbers spelled out before comparing). First calibration on 12 takes gave f0 150.7 Hz, too low for a whole episode (episode median 156 Hz).
